title: Correct acceleration value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the minimum acceleration as 2 m/s².

title: Correct time value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the slide time as approximately 2.45 s.

title: Net force along slope
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law along the incline, identifying the net force as mg sinθ - f.

title: Correct sine calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate sinθ = h/l = 0.6 from the given geometry.

title: Kinematic equation application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use the correct constant-acceleration kinematic equation (s = ½at²) to find the slide time.

title: Sign error in net force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the resistance force f is incorrectly added to the component of gravity instead of subtracted.

title: Incorrect trigonometric ratio
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if sinθ is confused with cosθ or tanθ (e.g., using h/l for cosθ).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may show unit analysis for the final acceleration (m/s²) and time (s).
